meta.title: OpenAEC Browser — OpenAEC Foundation
meta.description: OpenAEC Browser: an open source Chromium-based browser for Windows, Linux and the OpenAEC SuperCloud. A calm start page without a news feed, Google search and ad blocking.

header.label: Coming soon
header.tagline: A calm browser for your work
header.desc: A Chromium-based browser with a start page free of news feeds and ads. Your own shortcuts and your SuperCloud environment are there as soon as you open a tab.

alt.start: The OpenAEC Browser start page in the dark theme, with search and shortcuts
alt.settings: The settings: SuperCloud address, ad blocking and taking your start page along
alt.shortcut: Adding a shortcut on the start page

why.label: Why
why.title: A new tab without the noise
why.desc: Most browsers open with news, recommendations and ads. In OpenAEC Browser a tab opens with a search field and the places you actually go to.
why.calm: Calm start page Google search and your own shortcuts. No news feed, and the page loads nothing from outside.
why.block: Ad blocking On by default, and off with a single switch.
why.cloud: Your SuperCloud at hand Enter the address of your own environment and it is on every new tab.
why.theme: Light and dark Follows your system theme, in the OpenAEC house style.

start.title: Search and shortcuts
start.desc: A large search field and your own shortcuts to tools, projects and portals. You add and remove them on the page itself.

settings.title: Take your start page along
settings.desc: Save shortcuts and your SuperCloud address to a local file and restore them on another profile. An import asks for confirmation first and refuses invalid files.

shortcut.title: Simple to manage
shortcut.desc: A name and a web address is all a shortcut needs. Everything stays local in your own profile.

status.label: Status
status.title: In development
status.desc: The start page, the settings and the basic blocking work and are tested in Chromium. It is not yet a standalone browser: the installers for Windows and Linux will follow.
status.works: Works now Start page, shortcuts, SuperCloud link, light and dark theme, basic blocking, exporting and importing the start page.
status.next: Next Signed installers, automatic updates, native tab styling and more complete filters.
status.cloud: With the SuperCloud The browser belongs to the OpenAEC SuperCloud workspace and will be rolled out there.

chromium.title: Chromium
chromium.desc: Stable Chromium versions pinned per platform, with source commit checks and downgrade protection.

upstream.title: Updated daily
upstream.desc: A daily check prepares new Chromium versions for review, so security updates come through quickly.

design.title: OpenAEC house style
design.desc: The same design tokens and fonts as the other OpenAEC apps, shipped locally.

cta.title: Want to try it first?
cta.desc: Let us know and you will hear as soon as the first installers are ready.
